purpose: Static educational close-view candidate; independent acceptance and publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain broad oval/paddle silhouette, disk and stout smooth stem. Concept has too few large inflated pods and little unit subdivision; model32 modules per row and five modest unit cues on each, with much shallower relief. Keep a continuous backing and preserve a distinct plain stem.

One broad paddle-shaped frond, plain substantial stalk and flattened circular holdfast. Two rows of 32 simple oblique pod-bearing lateral modules joined by a continuous backing; each bears five restrained unit cues. Front/back differentiation, with simpler posterior backing and no fractal rangeomorph architecture. A genus/species-level idealized positive fossil-form sculpture, not a replica of one fossil or a claim of living color. SAM P19690a supports complete outline but has a short stem; longer plain stem is an artistic choice within reported variable stem lengths. Relief, thickness and overall dimensions are interpretive. No exposed internal tube bundles or roots.
Complete original frozen brief/config/reference/concept preserved; exact dependency closure, counts and real measurements.
Exact GLB successfully parsed through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Actual device-renderer evidence required; CPU proof does not pass this stage.
Actual composed intended scene evidence required; unrun stays unknown.
